events.title: The Beatles' "White Album" Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the "White Album," on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling, iconic 'White Album'. Which track from the double LP is still on heavy rotation for you?

events.title: Freddie Mercury Tribute
events.blurb: November 24, 2026 marks 35 years since the passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who left us 35 years ago today. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' "Rubber Soul" Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album "Rubber Soul" on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Influence
angles.copy: A true classic turns 61 today. The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' shifted the sound of pop music forever.

events.title: John Lennon Tribute
events.blurb: December 8, 2026 marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles icon John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on. His legacy of peace and timeless music continues to resonate globally.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Music legend David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday on January 8, 2027.

angles.name: Bowie's Influence
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible artistry of David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today. A true innovator, his influence is still felt across music and culture.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have marked his 92nd birthday on January 8, 2027.

angles.name: The King Lives On
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we're still all shook up by the one and only Elvis Presley. The King lives on.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock icon Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday on January 9, 2027.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page. That iconic guitar sound is still sending shivers down our spines.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Rock and pop legend Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday on January 10, 2027.

angles.name: Still Rocking
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 82nd birthday to the incomparable Rod Stewart! Still rocking after all these years.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham "Suggs" McPherson, frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday on January 13, 2027.

angles.name: Nutty Boy Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the iconic voice of Madness! Still driving us all completely 'Nutty Boy'.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British singer Paul Young, known for hits like "Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)," celebrates his 71st birthday on January 17, 2027.

angles.name: Smooth Vocals
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the smooth vocals of Paul Young. Still making us swoon!

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Country music icon and entertainment legend Dolly Parton would have marked her 81st birthday on January 19, 2027.

angles.name: Dolly's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible legacy of Dolly Parton, who would have turned 81 today. Her music and spirit continue to shine.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday on January 20, 2027.

angles.name: Shine Bright
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! Still 'Shine'-ing bright.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: British R&B singer Billy Ocean, known for hits like "Caribbean Queen," celebrates his 77th birthday on January 21, 2027.

angles.name: Caribbean King
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the fantastic Billy Ocean! You can 'Get Outta My Dreams, Get Into My Car' any time.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame Inaugural Ceremony Anniversary
events.blurb: The first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held on January 24, 1989, inducting pioneers like Elvis Presley and The Beatles.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: 38 years ago today, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its first ever induction. Who do you think was the most deserving of that initial honour?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday on January 27, 2027.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 55th birthday to the charming Mark Owen! Still got that 'Greatest Day' feeling.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their iconic final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters on January 30, 1969.

angles.name: Rooftop Farewell
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles made history with their legendary rooftop concert. What an incredible way to say goodbye.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Legendary musician Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday on January 30, 2027.

angles.name: Musical Powerhouse
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the one and only Phil Collins! Still 'Against All Odds', he's a true musical powerhouse.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Hugh Grant celebrates his 67th birthday on January 31, 2027.

angles.name: Charming Actor
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 67th birthday to the charming Hugh Grant! From Notting Hill to Wonka, he always delivers.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday on January 31, 2027.

angles.name: Pop Prince
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! Still bringing the 'SexyBack' and the hits.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British actor Sir David Jason celebrates his 87th birthday on February 2, 2027.

angles.name: National Treasure
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! Lovely jubbly!

events.title: The Day The Music Died Anniversary
events.blurb: February 3, 2027 marks 68 years since the tragic plane crash that killed music pioneers Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

angles.name: Music History Tragedy
angles.copy: 68 years ago today, we lost three incredible talents in a single, tragic event. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper on 'The Day The Music Died'.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Pop icon Rick Astley celebrates his 61st birthday on February 6, 2027.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give Up
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to the legend that is Rick Astley! We're never gonna give him up.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae superstar Bob Marley would have celebrated his 82nd birthday on February 6, 2027.

angles.name: Marley's Message
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Bob Marley on what would have been his 82nd birthday. His message of love and unity lives on.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Singer-songwriter legend Carole King celebrates her 85th birthday on February 9, 2027.

angles.name: Songwriting Queen
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the phenomenal Carole King! Her songs are the soundtrack to so many lives.

events.title: Whitney Houston Tribute
events.blurb: February 11, 2027 marks 15 years since the passing of global superstar Whitney Houston.

angles.name: Voice of a Generation
angles.copy: Remembering the voice of a generation, Whitney Houston, 15 years on. Her incredible talent continues to inspire.

events.title: Take That Split Anniversary
events.blurb: Take That announced their split on February 13, 1996, causing widespread heartbreak among fans.

angles.name: Take That Heartbreak
angles.copy: 31 years ago today, the world briefly stopped spinning for many as Take That announced their split. Thankfully, they eventually came back!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68

angles.name: Red Red Wine Voice
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell, the unmistakable voice of UB40! Still making us feel 'Red Red Wine'.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36

angles.name: Thinking Out Loud
angles.copy: Happy 36th birthday to the phenomenal Ed Sheeran! He's still 'Thinking Out Loud' and delivering hit after hit.
